question: Rs. 1500 is lent out at 6 % per annum simple interest for 3 years. Find the amount after 3 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest rate for 3 years = 6% × 3 = 18%

Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 100% + 18% = 118%

Total Amount = 118% of 1500

⇒ Amount = (118 × 1500) ÷ 100 = 1770

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1770.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1500

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + I
